title: Article 350 — Language to be used in representations for redress of grievances

content.overview: Article 350 provides that every person shall be entitled to submit a representation for the redress of any grievance to any officer or authority of the Union or a State in any of the languages used in the Union or in the State, as the case may be.
content.glance: Any person may submit a grievance representation to Union or State authorities in any language used in the Union or in the State respectively.
content.study:
Article 350 is a citizen-facing language right for grievance redress:
- Representation for redress of any grievance.
- To any officer or authority of the Union or a State.
- In any of the languages used in the Union or in the State, as the case may be.

Examination: grievance representations; any language used in Union/State; broad access.

sections.heading: Key rule
sections.body: Every person may submit a grievance representation to any Union or State officer/authority in any language used in the Union or in the State respectively.

questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 350 provides that every person shall be entitled to submit a representation for the redress of any grievance to any officer or authority of the Union or a State in any of the languages used in the Union or in the State, as the case may be.
